name: Default
shortDescription: Local-first bookmark manager that saves links, extracts readable content and searches it by keyword or meaning, with optional AI summaries and tagging.

alerts.message: Grimoire has no login of its own, so the template puts it behind HTTP basic auth: sign in with GRIMOIRE_USERNAME and GRIMOIRE_PASSWORD from the environment variables. Only the MCP, capture and browser integration routes skip it, because Grimoire requires an integration token there.
Grimoire is single-user. AI summaries, tagging and semantic search are optional and need a provider API key or an Ollama endpoint set in Settings.
